source: CDC Advisory Committee on Immunization Practices (ACIP)

adult_schedule.description: Annual flu vaccine recommended for everyone 6 months and older.
adult_schedule.notes: Recommended every year, ideally by end of October.

adult_schedule.description: Updated COVID-19 vaccine recommended annually for everyone 6 months and older.
adult_schedule.notes: Updated formulation recommended each fall season.

adult_schedule.description: One dose of Tdap if not previously given; Td booster every 10 years.
adult_schedule.notes: Tdap preferred in pregnancy (27–36 weeks) regardless of prior Tdap.

adult_schedule.description: Recommended for adults 65+ and younger adults with certain conditions.
adult_schedule.frequency: series; timing depends on product and prior vaccination
adult_schedule.notes: Consult CDC schedule for specific product recommendations and intervals.
Second dose 2–6 months after first. Recommended even if prior chickenpox or shingles.

adult_schedule.description: Single dose for adults 60+ (shared clinical decision making) or 75+.
adult_schedule.notes: Also recommended in pregnancy 32–36 weeks for infant protection.

adult_schedule.description: Routine vaccination for adolescents 11–12; catch-up through age 26. Shared decision making ages 27–45.
adult_schedule.notes: 2 doses if started before age 15; 3 doses if started at 15 or older or immunocompromised.

adult_schedule.description: 2-dose series for adults at increased risk or anyone who wants protection.
adult_schedule.notes: Risk factors: travel, liver disease, homelessness, drug use, close contact with adoptee from endemic country.

adult_schedule.description: 3-dose series recommended for unvaccinated adults through age 59; shared decision making at 60+.
adult_schedule.notes: Heplisav-B: 2 doses. PreHevbrio: 3 doses. Check serology if uncertain about prior vaccination.
